messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — canary wave=alpha-7 | metric=5xx_rate | window=1m | value=8.7% | deploy=deploy-3982
sara: on it, what regions are flaring?
mike: primarily ap-southeast and us-west-2, POST /v1/chat.complete returning 502s
maya: stack traces show 'tokenizer_state_error' in the quant runtime path after 2x longer seqs
amy: just to confirm, deploy-3982 is the v3-quant roll with new attention kernels?
tim: yes, v3-quant rolled as a canary at 5% traffic, started 3m ago
sara: flip the canary kill flag now to stop new sessions hitting v3-quant
sara: ```
# disable canary routing for v3-quant
curl -X PATCH https://flags.internal/ff.route_v3_quant -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
ops-bot: Flag ff.route_v3_quant disabled by sara at 2024-07-02T22:05:11Z :white_check_mark:
mike: traffic to v3-quant dropping, but existing sticky sessions still hitting it and crashing
sara: initiate control-plane abort for deploy-3982 to shift remainder immediately
sara: `redwoodctl rollout abort --deploy deploy-3982 --reason "tokenizer_state_error in quant path"`
ops-bot: Abort submitted for deploy-3982 by sara — rebalancing traffic to stable model (v3-safe) :hourglass:
maya: eu pods are failing liveness checks and entering crashloop backoff, kube events show OOM on tokenizer thread
amy: contacting SEs for impacted customers: CloudLens and FinGrid — both reported intermittent failures via priority channel
sara: set canary replicas to 0 for alpha-7 to speed draining
sara: `k scale deploy alpha-7-canary --replicas=0 -n canary-wave`
ops-bot: scaled alpha-7-canary replicas to 0 by sara
mike: 5xx rate down to 1.1% globally, ap-southeast at 1.8% and falling
tim: creating incident ENG-2024-412 with initial notes and SLO impact windows
amy: support updated both customers — CloudLens saw ~4 minutes of 502s, FinGrid ~2 minutes; no data loss reported
sara: capture core dumps, logs, and tokenizer traces to s3://incidents/ENG-2024-412/ for forensics
maya: uploaded coredumps and traces, path s3://incidents/ENG-2024-412/artifacts/; also saved failing request ids to /failures.txt
ops-bot: Artifacts uploaded by maya — presigned links sent to oncall@redwood for 7d retention
mike: quick hypothesis: new quant attention kernels reorder tokenizer state under certain multi-threaded requests leading to state corruption + crash
sara: mitigation checklist: 1) abort deploy (done) 2) disable canary flag (done) 3) scale canary replicas to 0 (done) 4) relax alerting to avoid noisy pages while we monitor
tim: handoff: sara -> tim in 25m. please monitor dashboards, relax thresholds to 3x for 30m, and watch for re-escalation. I'll file a follow-up postmortem and schedule a 90min incident review tomorrow 09:30 UTC
sara: adding follow-up items in ENG-2024-412: pin v3-quant in model catalog, add tokenizer CRC checks in runtime, add canary gating on tokenizer errors, expand canary to include seq-length stress tests
amy: notifying customers of brief degraded window and mitigation steps — sending templated follow-up now
ops-bot: Incident ENG-2024-412 created by tim — status: mitigated -> monitoring
sara: thanks team, closing live mitigation loop here. will attach timeline to ENG-2024-412 and post summary in #incidents
tim: ack, will take night watch and open follow-up PRs if we see any regressions
